authorization_effect: Frozen theory-only protocol; effective after verified preparation archive.

expected_quantities_unverified.carry: Candidate deg C_p=p-1 with coefficient -1/2; pole and reduced pole 2p-2; conductor degree 2p-1.
expected_quantities_unverified.canonical: Source-based candidate deg_X x_1=(3p-1)/2, hence F_can pole/reduced pole 3p-1 and conductor degree 3p for the specified global representative.
expected_quantities_unverified.scope: Candidates are not observed or independently reviewed results. No minimum over sample-equivalent functions is claimed.

proof_search_map.bottleneck: Exact ordinary digit/character interface and representative-dependent conductor at precision two.

baseline_embedding.parameter_slice: Precision one, ordinary x coordinate on E minus O.
baseline_embedding.reproduction_check: Derive the ordinary x pole and length-one additive-character convention, handle O explicitly; no numerical run.

observation_collision.observable: Values of a phase on affine E(F_p).
observation_collision.distinct_preimage_search: Symbolically compare zero and (x^p-x)x; compare F_can with its remainder modulo X^p-X. Compute global and reduced poles separately.

proof_search_map.quantifier_order: For every p>3 and ordinary smooth short-Weierstrass E/F_p, fix its canonical lift and compatible coordinates before constructing x_1. C_p is uniquely fixed by canonical integer representatives. Prove claimed identities uniformly. The choice of an arbitrary sample-equivalent rational representative is not permitted to inherit the original representative's conductor.

method_ceiling.strongest_certifiable_claim: Exact identities and conductor of explicitly named functions in F_p(E), plus a scoped applicability statement for a full affine-curve character bound.
method_ceiling.nearby_object_control: Constant vectors, whole-Witt versus coordinate phases, Artin-Schreier coboundaries, and sample-equivalent functions with different global conductors; optional p=5 source fixture is only a representation control.

deliverables: Derivation note with separate lemmas for digit identity, carry polynomial, canonical representative, reduced poles, source applicability and sample-equivalence control.
Machine-readable joint outcomes, precise unresolved obligations, source provenance and own runtime/read disclosure; no invented measured values.
stopping_rules: Stop at 900 seconds; return incomplete derivation as inconclusive, not negative mathematical evidence.
Stop a downstream conclusion whenever its exact observable, source hypotheses, character nontriviality or representation binding is unproved.
No experiments, commands, computer algebra, recovery algorithm, implementation, new record identifier, or status transition.

decision_branches.expected: If identities hold, report only named global representative conclusions; offer a precisely bounded sample-reduction/cancellation successor for later ranking.
decision_branches.unexpected: Preserve a concrete counterderivation or unresolved contradiction and route to independent review; no self-promotion.
decision_branches.inconclusive: Record missing proof/source/transfer or resource condition. Keep all untested routes open.
